Hi, I’m Daria Androshchuk — face massage specialist, spa owner, and mentor with over 10 years of hands-on experience!

On this channel, I share professional techniques and business insights to help you grow — whether you’re just getting into mindful self-care, already working as a massage therapist, or running your own spa.

Subscribe and join me on this journey — together, we’ll turn face massage into a powerful tool for transformation, growth, and lasting results — inside and out.
